command:
cd /app && python3 - <<'PY'
p='promql/sort.go'
s=open(p).read()
replacements = [
    ('func unit(ns int64) *big.Rat { return ratFromInt64(ns) }', 'func unitMult(ns int64) *big.Rat { return ratFromInt64(ns) }'),
    ('\tsecond = int64(time.Second)\n\tminute = int64(time.Minute)\n\thour   = int64(time.Hour)\n\tday    = 24 * hour\n\tweek   = 7 * day\n\tyear   = 365 * day', '\tdurationSecond = int64(time.Second)\n\tdurationMinute = int64(time.Minute)\n\tdurationHour   = int64(time.Hour)\n\tdurationDay    = 24 * durationHour\n\tdurationWeek   = 7 * durationDay\n\tdurationYear   = 365 * durationDay'),
    ('{names: []string{"ns"}, mult: unit(1)},', '{names: []string{"ns"}, mult: unitMult(1)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"us", "µs", "μs"}, mult: unit(int64(time.Microsecond))},', '{names: []string{"us", "µs", "μs"}, mult: unitMult(int64(time.Microsecond))},'),
    ('{names: []string{"ms"}, mult: unit(int64(time.Millisecond))},', '{names: []string{"ms"}, mult: unitMult(int64(time.Millisecond))},'),
    ('{names: []string{"s"}, mult: unit(second)},', '{names: []string{"s"}, mult: unitMult(durationSecond)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"m"}, mult: unit(minute)},', '{names: []string{"m"}, mult: unitMult(durationMinute)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"h"}, mult: unit(hour)},', '{names: []string{"h"}, mult: unitMult(durationHour)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"d"}, mult: unit(day)},', '{names: []string{"d"}, mult: unitMult(durationDay)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"w"}, mult: unit(week)},', '{names: []string{"w"}, mult: unitMult(durationWeek)},'),
    ('{names: []string{"y"}, mult: unit(year)},', '{names: []string{"y"}, mult: unitMult(durationYear)},'),
]
for old,new in replacements:
    assert old in s, old
    s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY
gofmt -w promql/sort.go && timeout 120 go test ./promql/ -run 'TestCompareLabelValues|TestNaturalCompareLeadingZeroTie' -count=1 2>&1 | tail -10
